bangalore-rain-variation-2026.subtitle: Daily rainfall from 28 WeatherUnion stations shows a Bangalore whose wettest and driest parts can be hundreds of millimetres apart.

september-rain-intensity.subtitle: September has fewer rainy days than July and August, but they are a little heavier. May’s rainy days are heavier still.

bangalore-second-summer.subtitle: September brings a recurring afternoon-heat rebound, especially in dry years, but the nights keep it from becoming a true second summer.

september-rain-heat-lag.subtitle: Recent rain is linked with cooler September afternoons but warmer nights. The effect is modest, but the two directions are the interesting part.

september-evening-temperature.subtitle: Through September 23, Bangalore's evening temperatures are unusually high, with the September opening especially far above its historical comparison.
